title: 10 Lessons I Learned After Leaving the Church (And Why I'm Never Going Back)

top_liked.author: @HeathenGirl
top_liked.text: "Morality is a human trait, not a religious one."  I have never heard it stated so clearly.  I will use this going forward!

top_liked.author: @austinmiller8356
top_liked.text: Y’all ever notice how the Bible keeps referring to us as children, plants, or sheep? It’s a way of convincing you that you need help and you will be lost and doomed unless you get saved. But I am not a plant or a child or sheep. I am a grown ass man.

top_liked.author: @tombyrne7784
top_liked.text:
Sir, I was a Catholic priest for almost ten years. The experiences and discoveries that you share echo strongly in my own life.
I thank you for your clarity and honesty vis a vis the struggles and eventual personal liberation that comes with letting go.

top_liked.author: @janisnotjoplin1
top_liked.text: I am my own master. I need no shepherd for I am not a sheep.

top_liked.author: @Layola_Pops
top_liked.text: I was an arsehole while in the church, living a double life of being God's most devote soldier; evangelizing and preaching the word to others while in the background I was controlled by my lust. Having new partners every now and then. I discovered Brandon's video on Mindshift…

top_liked.author: @coffeebux
top_liked.text: I didnt go to church on Sunday last week for the first time in years

top_liked.author: @roc5291
top_liked.text: The things I learned after leaving Christianity is how powerful indoctrination can be. How much of what people believe was installed into us and was purely based on the time and place we were born in. I learned to have much more compassion towards people of all walks of life…

top_liked.author: @brenatevi
top_liked.text: My first real step from Christianity was realizing that I was no longer afraid of Hell. After that, Heaven stopped being necessary, and if Heaven wasn't necessary, what use was God?

top_liked.author: @Fullmetal1890P
top_liked.text: I always say, I was never a worse person than when I was a good Christian.
